description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Timing Tensioner and Spring Set for the 1.6 Liter / 16 Valve engine.
These engines are found in the 1992 – 1998 Model Years Trackers and Sidekicks.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Plate, Timing Tensioner
Qty 1 – Spring, Timing Tensioner Plate
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Geo Tracker 1992 – 1998 All Models
Suzuki Sidekick 1992 – 1998 All Models
